question: Can the current holding, public surrogate, or target 3482/3483 annotations of Gao Xizeng's annotated 《铁琴铜剑楼藏书目录》 be directly closed from presently accessible evidence?
answer: NO. A 2026 bibliographic-survey publication discussion attests the existence and research use of a Gao Xizeng annotated Tieqin catalog recording books handled during the Qu-family transfer work. Independent modern publication records show that other Gao manuscripts and bibliographical notes survived into an editorial/research chain connected with Gao's family and Hebei University scholars. However, no reviewed source identifies the current holding institution or shelfmark of the target annotated catalog, exposes a lawful public digital surrogate, or reproduces the target Tonghu/Zhunzhai 3482/3483 annotations. Holding/access and target annotation remain unresolved.

observed_claims: Gao Xizeng accompanied Zhao Wanli in collecting Qu-family books.
Gao left an annotated copy of 《铁琴铜剑楼藏书目录》.
The annotated copy contains detailed annotations on books he handled.
The survey discussion uses this kind of historical catalog comparison to trace Qu-family book destinations.

gao_xizeng_xueshu_wencun_2022.title: 赵林涛辑校《高熙曾学术文存：中国古代文学经典讲义》
observed_claims: The volume includes material organized from Gao Xizeng manuscripts.
Gao's daughter Gao Tingting wrote the first preface.
The family preface records Gao's 1950 transfer into Beijing Library rare-books work under Zhao Wanli and says he left many valuable records.
Editor Zhao Lintao has long worked at Hebei University.
